name: Question 10
problem:
Suppose we take a random sample of size $n=76$ from a population where $24%$ of the population has a particular characteristic. Find a normal approximation for the probability that more than $30%$ of the sample has the characteristic. You may assume that the population size is significantly larger than the sample size.

*Hint: A table of values of $Φ(z)$ for different values of $z$ are given below, where $Φ(z)$ is the cumulative distribution function for the standard normal distribution.*

| $z$ | $\,0.00\,$ | $\,0.01\,$ | $\,0.02\,$ | $\,0.03\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\,1.2\,$ | $\,0.8849\,$ | $\,0.8869\,$ | $\,0.8888\,$ | $\,0.8907\,$ |
| $\,1.3\,$ | $\,0.9032\,$ | $\,0.9049\,$ | $\,0.9066\,$ | $\,0.9082\,$ |
| $\,1.4\,$ | $\,0.9192\,$ | $\,0.9207\,$ | $\,0.9222\,$ | $\,0.9236\,$ |
worked_solution:
Given a population in which a proportion $p$ of the population has a particular characteristic, the sampling distribution of the sample proportion $\overset{^}{\,p}$ can be approximated as

$$
\overset{^}{\,p}∼N(p,\frac{p(1-p)}{n}),
$$

where the sample size $n$ is much smaller than the population size, $np>5,$ and $n(1-p)>5.$

In our case

- the sample size is $n=76,$ and

- the population proportion is $p=0.24.$

Now, since

$$
np=76(0.24)=18.24>5
$$

and

$$
n(1-p)=76(1-0.24)=57.76>5,
$$

and $n=76$ is much smaller than the population size, we can apply the above approximation.

The sampling distribution of the sample proportion, in this case, can be approximated as

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{^}{\,p} & ∼N(p,\frac{p(1-p)}{n}) \\  & ∼N(0.24,\frac{0.24(1-0.24)}{76}) \\  & ∼N(0.24,0.0024).\end{aligned}
$$

The probability we wish to find is
$P(\overset{^}{\,p}>0.3).$
So, we convert $\overset{^}{\,p}$ to a standard normal random variable by $z$-scoring:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(\overset{^}{\,p}>0.3) & =P(Z>\frac{0.3-0.24}{\sqrt{0.0024}}) \\  & ≈P(Z>1.22) \\  & =1-P(Z<1.22) \\  & =1-Φ(1.22).\end{aligned}
$$

From the table, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}Φ(1.22) & =0.8888.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(\overset{^}{\,p}>0.3) & =1-Φ(1.22) \\  & =1-0.8888 \\  & =0.1112.\end{aligned}
$$
